README.title: Athena-Only Hospital Revenue Cycle Charge Demo
README.subtitle: Independent synthetic demonstration workbook. It is not an Epic product, replica, extract, or proprietary build.
columns: Provides expanded inpatient and outpatient charge-detail views spanning the smallest supplies to the largest procedures, with CDM controls, billing edits, contracts, governance, and auditability.
Provides an original hospital revenue-cycle dataset with separate inpatient and outpatient charge-detail views, CDM controls, routing, billing edits, contracts, governance, and auditability.

records.Provides an original hospital revenue-cy: Uses common US hospital billing concepts such as hospital accounts, charge routing, workqueues, facility/professional split, institutional claims, and reimbursement. No proprietary EHR design is reproduced.
CDM Master; IPD Encounter; Charge Router Rules; Claim Edits; Payer Contracts; Price Transparency; Governance; Audit Trail; Data Source Map; Data Dictionary; Dashboard.
Blue = editable input; black = formula/derived; green = linked/imported; gray = static reference; orange = review; red = error/hold; purple = control logic; teal = KPI/visualization.
All patients, payers, prices, contracts, identifiers, effective dates, and operational scenarios are synthetic. No PHI is included.

Epic public financial interface documentation: https://open.epic.com/Financial/Billing
CMS Hospital Price Transparency: https://www.cms.gov/priorities/key-initiatives/hospital-price-transparency
CMS technical implementation guide: https://github.com/CMSgov/hospital-price-transparency
